title: Woodland Sanctuary Chassis Dress Mk.15
flow_prompt: Adorned with crafted botanical-fae chassis dress regalia accented in warm burnished bronze and glowing emerald filigree, the companion stands with serene poise in the bright studio light as her two glowing green eyes shine with gentle warmth. She performs a graceful aegis breathing cadence and shifts her weight smoothly while her copper braided hair sways softly across her shoulder, offering an encouraging smile before settling seamlessly back into her starting stance. Locked static camera, clean solid white studio backdrop, no floating text or overlays. Audio: in a warm, gentle, natural human voice—never robotic—she says, "Let's practice calm focus together," with a soft emerald chime in a dry studio with no background music.

audio_script.script: Let's practice calm focus and gentle dew together—every calm breath builds our guild sanctuary.

quest_hook.title: Practice Calm Focus & Gentle Dew
quest_hook.prompt: Complete one aegis session with Willow (+20 AP).

dialogue_lines: Willow adjusts her botanical-fae gear: 'Ready to practice calm focus and gentle dew!'
The desktop kittens purr in sync with aegis (+20 AP).
